purpose: What `./build.sh -q` produces on a fresh checkout with no `.settings` and no `.env`: the forced profiles plus every default-on profile.
notable_env: mongo sizing pinned to the 16 GB host tier
notes: Baseline every other reference deployment is diffed against.

purpose: The default build with CUDA enabled for realtime and Expresso, plus the Expresso trainer worker. Requires an NVIDIA GPU and the nvidia container runtime on the host.
notable_env: `REALTIME_TAG_DEFAULT_GPU` and `EXPRESSO_SERVER_TAG_DEFAULT_GPU` set to `latest-gpu` by the hidden settings of the CUDA sub-profiles

purpose: Internet-facing variant: Let's Encrypt certificate provisioned through the DigitalOcean DNS API for `<SERVER_NAME>.pacefactory.dev`, MQTTS published on 8883, plain MQTT (1883) not published.
Internet- or intranet-facing variant using a certificate file the site provides (no certbot), MQTTS published on 8883, plain MQTT (1883) not published.
notes: Certificate and key expected at `credentials/ssl/live/<SERVER_NAME>/`; see [Enable HTTPS](../../../how-to/enable-https.md).

purpose: The default build plus the Alert Processing Engine, which force-enables `rdb` and `expresso-010`. Autozone is deliberately not included.
notes: APE publishes its two HTTP ports on ephemeral host ports.

purpose: The default build with the `offline` profile: dbserver autodelete disabled and audit processing in offline mode, for running recorded video through the Offline Processing tool.
notes: Configuration-only difference from the default build; no extra services.
